calls.title: Judge speed by the visible page
calls.chose: Measure time to first readable pixels and a filled viewport; use 4x as the initial target and 10x as the stretch target.
calls.because: Background completion can improve while Alt+O still feels slow. The user asked for the opening experience.
calls.undo: Change the acceptance thresholds before implementation.

verdict.note: Parker authorized the complete plan on 2026-11-05.

calls.title: Measure retained pages before choosing a cache policy
calls.context: A recommendation for the revised plan; production implementation is still unapproved.
calls.chose: Measure nine retained page contexts using the real renderer; propose disk reuse and release of browser pages, with recent panes used for priority.
calls.because: Parker asked for resource cost first. Nine retained pages used 1975 MiB browser RAM; cached PNG reads were only 1–6 ms.
passed_over: Keep nine complete live browser pages as the fast cache
calls.undo: Revise the recommendation; no product behavior has changed.

verdict.note: Parker explicitly authorized the resource-first implementation after reviewing the cost study on 2026-11-05.

calls.title: Preparation stays bounded
calls.chose: Prepare the newest HTML from up to nine recently visited panes, one page at a time, after a 400 ms dwell; keep completed pixels on disk within the existing 256 MiB budget.
calls.because: The native fifty-pane run met the prepared-open target while hidden views retained no image tiles. No measured benefit yet justifies preparing additional hovered artifacts.
passed_over: Extra hover-triggered preparation and a pinned image-memory cache
calls.undo: Change the preparation candidate policy and constants
